core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ramazan corresponds to the Turkish form رَمَضَان (Turkish Ramazan, from Arabic رَمَضَان). Its core sense is ramazan; ramadan (turkish/persian form). Ramazan is the Turkish/Persian form of Arabic رَمَضَان (Ramaḍān), the ninth month of the Islamic calendar, used as a male given name. The source gloss 'Month of Fasting' is broadly consistent. Same name as ramadan.

urdu.name: رمضان
